nodes.description: SafeMath library multiplication; computes c = a * b and asserts overflow safety.
SafeMath library division; Solidity automatically reverts on divide by zero.
SafeMath library subtraction; asserts b <= a to prevent underflow.
SafeMath library addition; asserts c >= a to prevent overflow.
Public totalSupply declared in ERC20Basic base contract.
Public transfersEnabled flag declared in ERC20Basic; gates all transfers.
Public totalSupply redeclared in the ERC20 interface contract.
Public transfersEnabled flag redeclared in the ERC20 interface contract.
mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances; core accounting state.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of allowances.
Constant token name 'ETHernitymining'.
Constant token symbol 'ETM'.
Constant decimals value 18.
Constant initial supply 150 * 10**6 * 10**18.
Contract owner address; guards onlyOwner functions and receives claimed tokens.
Public transfer with onlyPayloadSize(2); moves _value from msg.sender to _to.
Constant view returning balances[_owner].
Public transferFrom with onlyPayloadSize(3); spends allowance and moves balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value unconditionally.
Constant view of allowed[_owner][_spender] guarded by onlyPayloadSize(2).
Adds _addedValue to the caller's allowance for _spender using SafeMath.add.
Decreases caller's allowance for _spender, clamping to zero when _subtractedValue exceeds oldValue.
Constructor assigning INITIAL_SUPPLY, minting to _owner and enabling transfers.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, blocking ether deposits.
onlyOwner function reassigning the owner state variable to _newOwner.
onlyOwner switch toggling the transfersEnabled flag.
onlyOwner function that reads the balance of an arbitrary token contract and transfers it to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for balance lookups, allowance indexing and owner checks.
balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) arithmetic credit inside transfer.
balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) arithmetic debit inside transfer.
External call token.transfer(owner, balances) on an attacker-supplied token address with no reentrancy guard.
External call token.balanceOf(this) on an attacker-controlled token contract.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) arithmetic allowance increase.
assert(msg.data.length == numwords * 32 + 4) short-address attack protection in modifier.
Comparison/clamping logic deciding whether allowance is zeroed or decremented.
balances[_from] = balances[_from].sub(_value) arithmetic debit inside transferFrom.
balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) arithmetic credit inside transferFrom.
